subject: Nathan: split dev and held-out judges (+ max_turns still 30)
body: Nathan's decision: the dev judge and held-out judge must be different models. configs/models.json roles: dev_judge stays openai:gpt-5.1; heldout_judges becomes ["openai-compat:openai/gpt-oss-120b"] only (drop gpt-5.1 from it). Reason: gpt-5.1 in both roles defeats held-out independence. Pilot scripts (c2_pilot.sh) stay on gpt-5.1, no change. Please also update the waiver text (now only gpt-oss-120b is the held-out judge, still OpenAI-family) and any E3b prereg/RUN_PILOT wording that lists gpt-5.1 as held-out. Separately: petri.max_turns is still 30 in configs/models.json:28; the 30 -> 10 change from e7171e9 has not landed. Nathan wants it before the baseline runs. Run python3 -m autoresearch.research.models_config + tests after.
